William King-Hall Admiral Sir William King-Hall (11 March 1816 – 29 July 1886) was a Royal Navy officer who went on to be Commander-in-Chief, The Nore. King-Hall joined the Royal Navy in 1829 and took part in operations off the coast of Syria in 1840. Promoted to Captain in 1853 he commanded HMS "Bulldog" during the bombardment and capture of Fort Bomarsund and then commanded HMS "Exmouth" during the attack on the Fortress of Sveaborg near Helsinki during the Crimean War.
